descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S02 Existing spec: Nursing Home dashboard counts the whole roster and stays live (liveness and totals only)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 With the dashboard open, the counts update without a page reload when a note is generated or an encounter is completed (UAT TC-20; TFA-92598 AC 3; TFA-92598 How it works 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • T3 The app counts every patient in Total and in exactly one of Pending (not yet prepped), In Progress and Complete, and shows the counts prominently (TFA-92598 How it works 1; TFA-92598 How it works 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Tim's resident test account. 50 filler residents plus the target, all created with inTodaysSession false, plus one patient in Hospital

When Open /snf, tap Dashboard. A second client moves the target through every status up to complete, resets it, removes it and adds another resident

Then Same assertions as S01 on /snf/dashboard

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions in rounding-dashboard.spec.ts. Its residents are not In Today, yet the test expects them counted. That contradicts U5 (TFA-92598 AC 4, TFA-92587 AC 6): a Pass here is counter-evidence for U5 and is not evidence for U2 or U5. It proves liveness and totals only. The spec is expected to start failing once TFA-92598 AC 4 is built; …

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S02 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-20.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 25acd72 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-15T14:04:39Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev, lane newspec-c (newspec-c/results.json, screenshots not attached).

Test method: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev/newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-20/S02

Existing spec: Nursing Home dashboard counts the whole roster and stays live (liveness and totals only)

Tickets: TFA-92598 Rounding Dashboard (ready for qa)

Detail:

Dev (, build 25acd727, live models), PW spec dsh-tc20-dev.spec.ts driving the app UI. Judged 10/10. 51 In Today residents + 1 not in today: Today's Visits Total 51 = the stored In Today rows, all 51 listed, the not-in-today resident absent; a resident added live appears (+1 Total / Pending in 0.3 s) and leaves when removed, no reload; the All Residents tab counts 52 and lists the not-in-today resident; back on Today's Visits it is gone.

Evidence: 1 attached; 1 not attached:

  • newspec-c/evidence/dsh-192030/evidence/d2-snf-dashboard.png — a dev screenshot, not attached

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A runs Tim's Playwright specs on the local stack: they sign in their own fixture accounts and write through e2e/support/backend.ts with the admin key; dev has neither (runner-contract §10), so this runs on the local stack only.. This dev newspec-c result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
